title: Multiomic Analyses Reveal Brainstem Metabolic Changes in a Mouse Model of Dravet Syndrome

evidence_spans.quote: Multiomic Analyses Reveal Brainstem Metabolic Changes
age-specific metabolic alterations in the brainstem of HET mice

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An empirical mouse study of Dravet-syndrome pathology at different postnatal ages; age-specific findings are not explicitly interpreted as aging biology.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Temporal brain metabolome alterations; brainstem metabolic, transcriptomic, and proteomic changes
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Metabolic changes in Scn1aA1783V/WT HET mice across ages/brain regions

evidence_spans.quote: We used Scn1aA1783V/WT DS mice to study temporal alterations in the brain metabolome
a Mouse Model of Dravet Syndrome

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed multiomic analyses in a named heterozygous mutant mouse genotype, which qualifies as an engineered genotype model with analyzed outcomes.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports metabolic and pathway alterations but no completed current-report assertion using a listed directional X-to-Y relation.
